svg.title: Lord of Wealth: Ten of Pentacles · Mercury in Virgo · Malkuth (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Mercury above the painting and Virgo below, as Book T places them: "The symbols of Mercury and Virgo are above and below."
